answer: Escrow with random audits: each new identity must post a bond before its work counts, and random audits re-derive its answer; a mismatch burns the bond and demotes the recruiter. Scaling to N fakes costs N bonds, and every audit failure pays a bounty, so the attacker's capital erodes with each round. The haven of honest standing compounds, a trellis of vouching links spreads the cost of one bad actor across sponsors, and the ocean of public evidence makes a repeated copy easy to spot.
